info.name: Nusantara Play - Calendar API
info.description: API Collection for Calendar Module - Important dates, personal schedules, public events integration, and invite system

item.name: Calendar - Views (Public)
item.description: Endpoints for viewing calendar data. No authentication required for public content; authentication gives access to internal and private items.

query.description: Include public events from Events module (default: true)

request.description:
Get calendar grouped by date for a full month. Returns all days in the month, each with an array of entries. Entries include calendar items + public events.

Visibility:
- Unauthenticated / publik role: public items + public events only
- pakar / kurator_daerah / admin_kpoti: + internal items
- All authenticated: + own private items + invited private items
Get calendar grouped by date for a specific week within a month. Returns 7 days.
Get all calendar entries in a date range as a flat paginated list. Sorted by start_date ASC. Useful for agenda/list view in frontend.

Get detail of a single calendar item including daerah, creator, and invites relations.

Access rules:
- public items: no auth needed
- internal items: requires auth with internal role
- private items: requires auth as creator or invited user

item.name: Important Dates (Admin & Kurator)
item.description:
CRUD for important dates. Accessible by admin_kpoti and kurator_daerah only.

Rules:
- Admin KPOTI: can create national (no daerah_id) or per-daerah important dates
- Kurator Daerah: can only create/edit important dates for their own daerah
- Visibility: public or internal only (not private)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Hari Permainan Rakyat Nasional",
  "description": "Peringatan tahunan permainan rakyat Indonesia",
  "start_date": "2026-03-02T00:00:00.000Z",
  "all_day": true,
  "color": "#E74C3C",
  "visibility": "public"
}

request.description:
Create a new important date.

Field rules:
- visibility: 'public' or 'internal' only (NOT private)
- daerah_id: optional; Kurator Daerah auto-fills with their own daerah if omitted
- color: hex format #RRGGBB (e.g. #FF5733)

Kurator Daerah restrictions:
- daerah_id must match their own daerah
- If daerah_id is omitted, it's auto-set to their daerah

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Hari Jadi Kota Bandung",
  "description": "Peringatan HUT Kota Bandung ke-216",
  "start_date": "2026-09-25T00:00:00.000Z",
  "all_day": true,
  "color": "#2ECC71",
  "visibility": "public",
  "daerah_id": "{{daerahId}}"
}

request.description: Create an important date tied to a specific daerah. Admin can set any daerah_id; Kurator Daerah can only use their own daerah_id.

body.raw:

request.description: Create an internal important date visible only to admin, kurator, and pakar.

Get all important dates for management. Returns paginated result.

- Admin KPOTI: sees all important dates
- Kurator Daerah: sees only their daerah's important dates + national ones (no daerah_id)

Update an important date. All fields are optional.

- Admin KPOTI: can update all important dates
- Kurator Daerah: can only update important dates created by themselves or tied to their daerah
- Cannot change visibility to 'private'
Delete an important date. Same ownership rules as update.

item.name: Personal Schedule (Authenticated)
item.description:
CRUD for personal schedules. All authenticated users can create their own schedules.

Visibility restrictions by role:
- publik: private only
- pakar / kurator_daerah: private or internal
- admin_kpoti: private, internal, or public

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Rapat Persiapan Festival",
  "description": "Koordinasi panitia festival egrang Bandung",
  "start_date": "2026-03-10T10:00:00.000Z",
  "end_date": "2026-03-10T12:00:00.000Z",
  "all_day": false,
  "color": "#3498DB",
  "visibility": "private"
}

request.description:
Create a private personal schedule. Only visible to the creator (and users they invite).

- visibility defaults to 'private' if omitted
- All authenticated users can create private schedules

  "end_date": "2026-03-15T15:00:00.000Z",
  "all_day": false,
  "color": "#F39C12",
  "visibility": "internal"
}

request.description:
Create an internal personal schedule visible to all internal users (admin, kurator, pakar).

Only available for: pakar, kurator_daerah, admin_kpoti
Create a multi-day all-day personal schedule. Appears on all days in the range in calendar view.
Get all personal schedules created by the currently authenticated user. Sorted by start_date ASC. Returns paginated result.
Update a personal schedule. Only the owner can update. All fields are optional.
Delete a personal schedule. Only the owner can delete.

item.name: Invites - Owner Actions
item.description:
Manage invites for a calendar item. Only the creator of the item can invite, view invites, and remove invites.

Invites are only for 'internal' or 'private' items — public items don't need invites.

request.description:
Invite one or more users to view a private/internal calendar item.

Accept user_ids (UUID array) OR emails (string array) OR both. At least one must be provided.

Rules:
- Only the creator can invite
- Cannot invite for public items
- Cannot invite yourself
- Duplicate invites are automatically skipped
- Emails not registered in the platform will return a 400 error

query.description: Filter by status: pending, accepted, declined (omit for all)

request.description: Get all invites for a specific calendar item. Only the creator can view. Returns paginated invite details with user info.

variable.description: UUID of the user whose invite to remove

request.description: Remove a user's invite from a calendar item. Only the creator can remove invites.

item.name: Invites - My Invites
item.description: Manage invites received by the currently authenticated user.

query.description: Filter status: pending, accepted, declined (omit for all)

request.description: Get all invites sent to the currently authenticated user. Paginated. Use ?status=pending to show only pending invites.

Accept an invite. After accepting, the calendar item will appear in the user's calendar view.

Only the invited user can update their own invite status.
Decline an invite. Cannot be reversed back to 'pending'.
